answer_1.quote: In recent years, pre-trained language models using transformer architectures have made remarkable strides in open-domain generation tasks... the Knowledge-Grounded Dialogue Generation (KGDG) task... we focus on its utilization... the goal is to generate an engaging and informative knowledge-infused response...

answer_2.quote: We choose perplexity (PPL) of the ground-truth responses, BOW Embedding (Avg., Ext.) , BLEU-1 , Knowledge Utilization Difference (KUD), and Porportion of Degenerated samples (PoD) as automatic metrics for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, We randomly select 50 responses in test seen set and 50 responses in test unseen set. We conducted an aspect-based pairwise preference test... asked five well-educated annotators to choose the superior response based on the following four aspects: (1) Coherence... (2) Engagingness... (3) Informativeness... (4) Interactiveness...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare pairs of responses and select the better one according to four aspects: Coherence, Engagingness, Informativeness, and Interactiveness.
